title: Lich
summary: Lich is a Krono-Titan whose appearance is that of a decayed skeleton of a Greek soldier. Lich is known to be the guardian of the tombs, notably the Tomb of the Undead.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Lich Titans were found to be guarding the [[TCG:PRO-19B|Tomb of the Undead]]. {{Source|TCG:PRO-19B|PRO-19B}}

A skeleton very similar to Lich was seen lying dormant in the shadows of the cave of [[the Oracle]] near the [[Temple of Poseidon]] in [[Greece]]. [[Lok Lambert]] was startled by the sight but did not assume it to be a [[Titan]]. {{source|The Unseen Guide}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
Lich is able lie dormant for years as a decayed corpse. However, once awake, he is able to devour his enemies or use his '''Life Drain''' ability to drain his enemies of their energy. He is also armed with a damaged but lethal sword. {{source|TCG:PRO-019|PRO-019}}
